Using integration by parts with  
\(u = \text{atan}(3*x)\) and \(dv = dx\), we get

\[
\int \text{atan}(3*x)\,dx
= x*\text{atan}(3*x) - \int x*\frac{3}{1+9*x**2}\,dx
\]

Now compute

\[
\int x*\frac{3}{1+9*x**2}\,dx
= \frac{1}{6}*\ln(1+9*x**2)
\]

Therefore,

\[
\int \text{atan}(3*x)\,dx
= x*\text{atan}(3*x) - \frac{1}{6}*\ln(1+9*x**2) + C
\]

<answer>x*atan(3*x) - 1/6*ln(1+9*x**2) + C</answer>
